rpc.date_in_future: you can't mark attendance for a future date.
rpc.enrollment_class_mismatch: a student on this list has moved class. Reload the list and save again.
rpc.enrollment_not_active: a student on this list has left the class. Reload the list and save again.
rpc.other: the server refused it. Reload the list and try again.

attendanceSummary.title: Attendance summary
attendanceSummary.dayEmpty: No classes with students this year
attendanceSummary.dayEmptyBody: Enrol students in a class first. Their attendance shows here once it's taken.
attendanceSummary.schoolTotal: %{taken} of %{classes} classes taken · %{absent} absent · %{late} late · %{leave} on leave
attendanceSummary.rangeEmpty: No students in this class this year
attendanceSummary.rateNote: At school = present + late, out of present + late + absent. Leave isn't counted.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.subtitle: Chapters, topics and concepts: the map every lesson, practice question and follow-up hangs on.
curriculum.subtitleTeacher: Topics and concepts for the subjects you teach this year.
curriculum.navHint: Topics, concepts and prerequisites for each chapter
curriculum.pickChapterBody: Its topics and concepts open here.
curriculum.noChapters: No chapters in this subject yet
curriculum.noChaptersAdmin: Add the first chapter, in textbook order.
curriculum.noChaptersTeacher: Ask the admin to add this subject's chapters first.
curriculum.noTopics: No topics in this chapter yet
curriculum.noTopicsBody: Split the chapter into the topics you teach. Each topic gets a short diagnostic and its own concepts.

tilesLabel.one: Students fill %{count} tile in this topic
tilesLabel.other: Students fill %{count} tiles in this topic

curriculum.noConcepts: No concepts yet. A concept is one idea a student can master, like "adding fractions with the same bottom number".
curriculum.retireTopicHint: Students stop seeing it. Its history stays.
curriculum.readOnly: You can read this chapter. Only its subject's teachers this year and admins can change it.

fields.titleUrHelper: Type it the way you'd say it in class. Leave empty to show the English.
fields.summaryHelper: One or two sentences. Shown above the lesson.
fields.diagnosticHelper: Questions in this topic's first check, %{min} to %{max}. Leave empty for %{def}.
fields.codeHelper: Short and unique, for example PTB-2025.
fields.name: Name
fields.effectiveFromHelper: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-04-01. Optional.

prereqs.title: Prerequisites
prereqs.help: Concepts a student should master before this one. Follow-ups send students back to these.
prereqs.noneEarlier: No earlier class has %{subject} concepts yet.
prereqs.loop: Can't pick: it already needs this concept, so that would make a loop.

curriculum.retiredToast: Retired. Turn on "Show retired" to bring it back.

errors.diagnosticNotNumber: Type a whole number, or leave it empty.
errors.codeRequired: Give the edition a short code.
errors.boardRequired: Name the board, for example Punjab Textbook Board.
errors.dateInvalid: Use a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.cycle: That would make a loop of prerequisites. Nothing was changed.
errors.duplicate: That code is already used by another edition.

editions.heading: Textbook editions
editions.body: Each chapter belongs to one edition (for example the Punjab Textbook Board books in use from April 2025). When the board prints new books, add a new edition and keep the old one for history.
editions.emptyBody: Add the edition your books are from (for example PTB-2025), then attach your chapters to it.
editions.retireHint: A retired edition stays on its chapters but isn't offered for new ones.

attach.heading: Chapters without an edition
attach.body: Chapters made before editions existed. Pick the edition, tick the chapters, attach.
attach.needEdition: Add an edition first, then attach chapters to it.

skipped.one: %{count} already had an edition and was left as it was.
skipped.other: %{count} already had an edition and were left as they were.

curriculum.notReady: The curriculum isn't switched on yet
curriculum.notReadyAdmin: The database update for chapters, topics and concepts (db/017, then db/023) hasn't been run on this project yet. Once it has, this screen fills in by itself.
curriculum.notReadyTeacher: The school hasn't switched on topics and concepts yet. Ask the admin; nothing is lost in the meantime.

importer.title: Import content
importer.subtitle: Drop one topic file: you get a report first, then every good item lands as a draft for review.
importer.navHint: Bring in a topic file: lesson, concepts and questions
importer.notReadyBody: The importer needs the content tables. Ask Hassan to run db/017, db/023 and db/031, then open this again.
importer.useComputerBody: Maths in a file is turned into pictures while it is checked, and that only happens in the browser. Open the console on a Windows PC or a Chromebook to import.
importer.pickChapterBody: The file's topic, concepts and questions go under the chapter you choose here.

drop.title: Drop the topic file here
drop.hint: One JSON file for one topic, as written by the content prompt. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

importer.pickQuestion: Pick a question to see what the checker found.
importer.matchInFile: Same as question %{ref} in this file (%{percent}%)
importer.skipSimilarDetail: %{count} questions look close to one already in the bank
importer.byPersonDetail: Leave this off for a file from the AI content prompt
importer.notePlaceholder: e.g. Class 9 Maths, chapter 2, first run
importer.willImport: %{questions} questions and %{lessons} lesson blocks will be saved as drafts.
importer.nothingToImport: Nothing left to import from this file.
importer.doneNext: Nothing is approved yet: a teacher checks each item in the review queue before students see it.
importer.noBatchesBody: Your imports show up here, so a bad one can be pulled back as a whole.
importer.retireBody: Its %{count} questions and its lesson stop being offered. Nothing is deleted, and papers that already used a question keep it.

errors.network: No internet connection. Nothing was saved; try again when you're back online.
errors.forbidden: You can only import into classes you teach. Ask an admin if this class should be yours.
errors.notConfigured: This app build has no backend set up.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again.
errors.retired: That batch was retired, so nothing more can be added to it.
errors.mismatch: The file doesn't match the chapter you picked. Start again and check the chapter.
errors.reason: Say why you are retiring the batch, in a few words.
errors.notJson: That file isn't JSON. Export the topic again from the content prompt.
errors.readFile: The file could not be read. Try choosing it again.
errors.noMath: Maths in this file could not be turned into pictures, so those questions are left out. Reload the page and try again.

issues.tooLarge: The file is bigger than %{detail} MB.
issues.tooManyQuestions: More than %{detail} questions in one file: split it by concept.
issues.wrongType: Not the right kind of value.
issues.badValue: Not a value the app can use.
issues.fieldIgnored: Not used by the app, so it was ignored.
issues.requiresUnknown: Needs %{detail}, which isn't in this file. Link it by hand in Curriculum.
issues.requiresLoop: The concepts need each other in a circle (%{detail}).
issues.conceptUnused: No question for concept %{detail}, so it gets no diagnostic.
issues.typeUnsupported: The app can't import questions of type %{detail}.
issues.correctMissing: The correct option isn't one of the options.
issues.correctNotSingle: Exactly one option must be correct.
issues.answerInvalid: The answer doesn't fit this question type.
issues.whyWrongUnknown: An explanation for option %{detail}, which doesn't exist.
issues.explanationMissing: No explanation, so students see no feedback.
issues.urMissing: No Urdu yet: a teacher adds it in review.
issues.duplicateInFile: The same question as number %{detail} in this file.
issues.similarInFile: Very close to question %{detail} in this file.
issues.similarInBank: Very close to a question already in the bank.
issues.mathUnbalanced: A $ sign with no closing $: the maths may be wrong.
issues.mathError: This maths could not be drawn: %{detail}
issues.blockTypeUnknown: %{detail} isn't a lesson block the app can show.
issues.lessonConceptUnknown: Points at concept %{detail}, which isn't in this file.
issues.altMissing: A picture needs a description in both languages.
issues.captionMissing: Every step needs a caption in both languages.
issues.svgUnsafe: The picture holds something that isn't allowed (%{detail}).
issues.svgTooBig: The picture is %{detail} KB: too big for a cheap Chromebook.
issues.svgTooManyElements: The picture has %{detail} parts: too many to draw smoothly.
issues.imageOrSvg: Give either a drawing or a photo, not both.
issues.sceneLayerMissing: The picture has no part named %{detail}.
issues.sceneLayerUnknown: A step moves %{detail}, which isn't listed as a moving part.
issues.sceneTooManyLayers: %{detail} moving parts: more than the app animates at once.
issues.stepTooLong: A step may last up to 4 seconds (found %{detail}).
issues.widgetUnknown: %{detail} isn't one of the app's interactive widgets.
issues.chartKind: %{detail} isn't a chart the app draws.
issues.chartSeriesLength: The chart has %{detail} values where it needs one per x value.
issues.hotspotRange: A tap point must sit inside the picture (0 to 1).
issues.transcriptMissing: No transcript, so the video is lost offline.
issues.notExamSafe: %{detail} can't be used on an exam question: only still pictures and charts.
issues.lessonExists: This topic already has a lesson, so this one was left out.

importer.addsToTopic: This topic is already there: %{concepts} of its concepts are reused, and %{lessons} lessons it already has are left out.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.subtitle: Preview every lesson as students will see it, then approve it, send it back or retire it.
lessons.notReadyBody: Run db/017, db/023 and db/031 on this project first (see db/README.md).
lessons.none: No lessons in this subject yet
lessons.noneBody: Import a topic file with a lesson in it; it arrives here as a draft.
lessons.sendBackBody: Say what needs to change. Students stop seeing it until it is approved again.
lessons.retireBody: Students stop seeing it. Nothing is deleted, and the history stays.
lessons.goneBody: It may belong to a subject you don't teach.

done.approve: Approved. Students can read it now.

errors.stale: Someone changed this lesson. It has been reloaded: look again before deciding.
errors.notReady: Lesson approval isn't switched on yet: run db/033 on this project.
errors.forbidden: Only a teacher of this subject (or an admin) can decide on this lesson.
